consultation with key farming, industry and research personnel. We are adding more weeds and pests

# Biology

the weed or pest life-cycle and where it is found

# Impact

how the weed or pest affects your crops, pasture and livestock

# Control

# Identification

- here's the lowdown on the ASW on [AgPest.co.nz][29]: [agpest.co.nz/?pesttypes=sad…][30]

**AgPest™ is a free tool to assist New Zealand farmers and agricultural professionals in
decision-making regarding weed and pest identification, biology, impact and management.**

AgPest contains a number of New Zealand pasture weeds and pests, which have been chosen in
consultation with key farming, industry and research personnel. We are adding more weeds and pests
to AgPest.

#### AgPest covers four main categories:

# Biology

the weed or pest life-cycle and where it is found

# Impact

how the weed or pest affects your crops, pasture and livestock

# Control

different methods used to control the weed or pest

# Identification

use the identify tab to identify a weed, pest or its damage

FAQ

## Common Questions

### How do I find a distributor in China?

We match your brand with 3 to 5 verified Chinese distributors from our network, based on your
product category, price point, and target region. We handle introductions in Mandarin. Timeline: 4
to 8 weeks from first call to signed agreement.

### How much does it cost to enter the Chinese market?

A basic offline distribution setup in one Chinese region starts from USD 5,000 to 15,000 for the
market entry phase. Adding Tmall Global or Douyin raises that. We give a specific cost estimate
after a free assessment call.

### How do I find distributors in Vietnam?

Vietnam distribution works through modern trade (Co.op, Vinmart), horeca in Ho Chi Minh City and
Hanoi, and e-commerce (Shopee VN, TikTok Shop). We match you with distributors active in your
specific channel.

### Do I need a local entity to distribute in Asia?

Not always. For China, cross-border e-commerce (Tmall Global, JD Worldwide) lets you sell without a
China entity. For offline distribution, a local distributor handles import and retail under their
own entity.

Amino Acids and Enzymes. It is the ultimate source of phyto-nutrients, is gluten free, has a neutral
ph without any artificial colors or preservatives. The chlorophyll molecule structure is similar to
haemoglobin, thus readily and speedily absorbed into cellular levels.

# What Makes BarleyGreen® Premium different?

BarleyGreen® is processed in a unique manner allowing it to retain all the vital nutrients and
active enzymes found in fresh barley grass juice. Dr. Yoshihide Hagiwara, founder of Green Foods
Corporation, discovered over 30 years ago that young barley grass is the most nutritionally balanced
foods in nature. 

As a renowned pharmacologist and president of his own pharmaceutical company in Japan, Dr. Hagiwara
was uniquely qualified to develop a process that would capture and protect all the delicate
phytonutrients in fresh young barley grass in an easy-to-consume, soluble powder. Dr. Hagiwara has
dedicated his career to perfecting the ideal whole food supplement that has helped millions of
people protect and regain their health

Barley grass is a green cereal grass that has adapted to a wide variety of climates and is an
excellent source of nutrition for both animals and humans. The young green blades of grass
concentrate large amounts of nutrients absorbed from the soil. When barley leaves are 12-14 inches
high, they contain all the vitamins, minerals, and proteins necessary for the human diet, in
addition to many other substances that help to keep us healthy including chlorophyll, many
antioxidants, and detoxifying compound.

# Supplement Ingredients & Custom Manufacturing for Global Wellness Brands

## Harnessing Nature's Power for a Healthier, Sustainable Future.

Essencefield supports supplement brands, private label companies, contract manufacturers, importers
and formulators with bulk ingredients, custom formulation and finished supplement manufacturing. We
help connect ingredient sourcing, dosage format development, documentation, packaging and bulk
production into one coordinated supply solution.

## Integrated Supplement Supply From Raw Materials to Finished Products

Supplement product development does not begin only at the production stage. Ingredient quality,
active specification, dosage form, solubility, taste, stability, packaging format, batch documents
and production control all influence whether a product can move smoothly from concept to market.

Essencefield supports buyers that need both bulk supplement ingredients and finished supplement
manufacturing. Our supply system helps supplement brands, private label companies, contract
manufacturers, importers, distributors, formulators and QA/QC teams review ingredients,
specifications, samples, formula direction, packaging options and documentation before bulk
production begins.

Whether you are sourcing one raw material, adjusting an existing formula or developing a new private
label supplement line, Essencefield provides practical support from ingredient selection to finished
product supply.

Essencefield organizes bulk ingredients by product type to help B2B buyers quickly find suitable raw
materials for supplement, food, beverage, cosmetic, and private label projects. Use the category
entrance below to browse herbal extracts, botanical powders, fruit and vegetable powders, nutrition
ingredients, food additives, polysaccharides, and cosmetic active ingredients for sample review,
documentation, and bulk supply.

Different supplement formats require different ingredient behavior, production conditions and
packaging choices. Essencefield helps buyers evaluate the right format before sample development and
bulk production.

# Supplement Ingredients & Custom Manufacturing for Global Wellness Brands

## Harnessing Nature's Power for a Healthier, Sustainable Future.

Essencefield supports supplement brands, private label companies, contract manufacturers, importers
and formulators with bulk ingredients, custom formulation and finished supplement manufacturing. We
help connect ingredient sourcing, dosage format development, documentation, packaging and bulk
production into one coordinated supply solution.

## Integrated Supplement Supply From Raw Materials to Finished Products

Supplement product development does not begin only at the production stage. Ingredient quality,
active specification, dosage form, solubility, taste, stability, packaging format, batch documents
and production control all influence whether a product can move smoothly from concept to market.

Essencefield supports buyers that need both bulk supplement ingredients and finished supplement
manufacturing. Our supply system helps supplement brands, private label companies, contract
manufacturers, importers, distributors, formulators and QA/QC teams review ingredients,
specifications, samples, formula direction, packaging options and documentation before bulk
production begins.

Whether you are sourcing one raw material, adjusting an existing formula or developing a new private
label supplement line, Essencefield provides practical support from ingredient selection to finished
product supply.

## Broad Ingredient Portfolio for Supplement Projects

Essencefield organizes bulk ingredients by product type to help B2B buyers quickly find suitable raw
materials for supplement, food, beverage, cosmetic, and private label projects. Use the category
entrance below to browse herbal extracts, botanical powders, fruit and vegetable powders, nutrition
ingredients, food additives, polysaccharides, and cosmetic active ingredients for sample review,
documentation, and bulk supply.

## OEM, Private Label and Supplement Development Services

In addition to bulk supplement ingredients, Essencefield supports OEM, private label and contract
manufacturing projects for dietary supplements, functional foods and wellness products. Whether you
start with a finished formula, selected ingredients or a simple product idea, our team helps connect
formulation, ingredient sourcing, packaging, labeling, pilot run and bulk supply into one practical
development process.

We work with supplement brands, functional food companies, distributors, importers and manufacturers
that need reliable ingredients, clear communication and flexible production support.

## Supplement Formats We Support

Different supplement formats require different ingredient behavior, production conditions and
packaging choices. Essencefield helps buyers evaluate the right format before sample development and
bulk production.

[ [Powder Supplement Icon] ][122]

### [ Powder Supplements ][123]

For drink mixes, sachets, tubs, stick packs and functional blends where solubility, flowability,
taste and moisture control matter.

[ [Capsule Supplement Icon] ][124]

### [ Capsule Supplements ][125]

For botanical extracts, vitamins, minerals, amino acids and custom blends that require consistent
fill weight and good powder flow.

[ [Tablet Supplement Icon] ][126]

### [ Tablet Supplements ][127]

For compressed formulas where powder properties, binder selection, hardness and disintegration
performance need to be reviewed.

[ [Softgel Supplement Icon] ][128]

### [ Softgel Supplements ][129]

For suitable oil-based or liquid-fill ingredients that require encapsulation feasibility and
stability consideration.

[ [Gummy Supplement Icon] ][130]

### [ Gummy Supplements ][131]

For chewable supplement products where taste, texture, active compatibility, flavor and packaging
stability are important.

[ [Liquid Supplement Icon] ][132]

### [ Liquid Supplements ][133]

For drops, shots, syrups, drink concentrates and functional liquid products requiring solubility,
taste and packaging compatibility review.

Essencefield supports supplement projects across major health and wellness categories, helping

selection, formulation planning, dosage format review and bulk production support.

Nutragreenlife Biotechnology Co.,ltd., a branch of Greenlife Biotechnology Co.,ltd, was set up in

Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Companies producing packaged food and beverages for distribution and sale.

Packaging Material Suppliers

Manufacturers and distributors of packaging materials, including labels, and packaging solutions.

Equipment Providers

Manufacturers and suppliers of food processing machinery, kitchen equipment, and packaging
machinery.

Commodity Traders

Traders dealing with commodities like grains, spices, oils, and other raw materials.

Wholesalers and Distributors
